newsitem.title: USA: 3Com, U.S. Robotics surge on positive outlook.
newsitem.headline: 3Com, U.S. Robotics surge on positive outlook.

text.p: Shares of 3Com Corp and U.S. Robotics Corp surged on Tuesday as some analysts said the outlook for networking companies is improving.
PaineWebber analyst Paul Weinstein said he reiterated his buy rating on 3Com, which he expects to report fiscal fourth quarter earnings of $0.47 a share, down from $0.48 a year ago.

"Although the results are lackluster, this should be the last tough comparison and we expect earnings can accelerate throughout fiscal 1998, especially once 3Com combines with USRX," Weinstein said in a report.
The proposed 3Com and U.S. Robotics merger agreed to in February is close to completion. Shareholders of both companies will vote on the deal at special meetings scheduled for June 11.
"Some people are becoming more bullish," Amar Senan, analyst with Volpe, Welty & Co, said of the merger.
Senan also said 3Com and U.S. Robotics have been undervalued despite being solid companies, and a general rebound in networking stocks has given them a boost.
"Although it's bounced off the bottom, it's relatively cheap," added Peter Swartz, an analyst with Salomon Brothers.

Swartz said there is still some concern about future price cuts for 3Com's networking products. But he added the market is more confident 3Com will post fourth quarter earnings in line with expectations.
"In the near term there are some positive trends," Swartz said.
Shares of 3Com were up 2-5/8 at 45-7/8 on turnover of more than 13 million shares, and U.S. Robotics rose 4-1/2 to 79-1/4, also in heavy trading.
